fichas.title: Units of Measurement in Building
fichas.summary: Reference table of SI, statutory, and older units used in building measurement, including symbols and conversion factors. The text states that the international system of measurement with SI units has been valid since 1 January 1978.
uses: Identify SI and statutory units used in building measurement
Convert between SI, statutory, and older units
